curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: collect objects with different masses from the immediate environment

mission.title: collect objects with different masses from the immediate environment

interactions.prompt: Tap the object you can pick up from a classroom.
interactions.feedback: Yes! A pencil is an object you can collect.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the small object you can carry with one hand.

interactions.prompt: Help the lion collect two objects with different masses. Tap the book and the stone.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each object to add it to the collection.
interactions.feedback: Great collecting! A book and a stone have different masses.
interactions.retryHint: Choose real objects you can hold. Leave the cloud.

interactions.prompt: Tap the two things you can collect at home for a mass game.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each object to add it to the basket.
interactions.feedback: Well done! A spoon and an orange are good objects to collect.
interactions.retryHint: Pick things you can touch and carry.

interactions.prompt: Which object can you collect from the playground?
interactions.feedback: Correct! You can collect a stone from the playground.

interactions.prompt: For a market stall game, collect two objects with different masses. Tap the tomato and the bag of flour.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each object to put it in the market basket.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! The tomato and flour bag are real objects with different masses.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the two things sold at the market.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Tap all the objects you can collect to explore mass.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each real object to make your collection.
interactions.feedback: Super work! You collected real objects with different masses.
interactions.retryHint: Choose objects you can touch. Do not choose the moon.
